name: CI / GitHub Actions
description: GitHub Actions CI (build/typecheck/lint/test) with Turbo cache, a per-target deploy workflow (Vercel/Railway/Fly.io/VPS), optional PR preview deploys, and Dependabot

questions.prompt: PR preview deploys? (Vercel-based; pair with deploy_target vercel/railway)
Build and push a Docker image in CI? (the docker template owns docker-build.yml; this records the intent)

checklist: Push to a feature branch and verify the CI workflow runs green (Actions tab)
Add required secrets: GitHub repo → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions (look for the # TODO comments in the generated workflow files)
Set TURBO_TOKEN (secret) and TURBO_TEAM (variable) for the remote Turbo cache — CI is much faster after the first run
The 'Validate env vars' step runs `check:env`, provided by the env-setup template; delete that step if you did not install env-setup
Merge to main and verify the deploy workflow triggers (only the workflow for your chosen deploy_target was generated)
If preview deploys are enabled, open a PR and verify the preview URL comment appears
Dependabot opens weekly PRs to keep Actions and dev dependencies current — review and merge them
